extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset collected from six participants living together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized third-person-view video references.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together for one week in a fully instrumented living environment, continuously recording their daily activities using Meta Aria AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, recording approximately eight hours daily. The environment was augmented with synchronized third-person perspectives captured from 15 additional cameras and two mmWave devices.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 300-hour collection of egocentric multimodal video data captured via Meta Aria glasses, synchronized with third-person perspectives from 15 cameras and 2 mmWave devices, covering daily activities including discussions, shopping, cooking, socializing, and entertainment. The dataset includes rich annotations with audio transcript and visual-audio narrations at various time granularity.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Multi-stage annotation process: 1) Speech recognition and diarization for transcripts, followed by human review and refinement; 2) Video narration by annotators using video editing software at 0.8× speed, covering all actions, interactions, and environmental details; 3) GPT-4o-mini merging of narrations into captions, then expansion with GPT-4o using frames and transcripts, verified by human annotators; 4) QA generation using GPT-4o with prompts for 5 question types, followed by rigorous human filtering (less than 1% retention), revision, and distractor generation. Annotators also labeled audio requirements and certification length (look-back time).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Video editing software with dubbing functions for caption annotation
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Human verification of AI-generated captions and rigorous filtering of QA candidates (less than 1% retention rate from 100K to 1K per participant, then further refined to 500 final QAs per participant)
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Speech recognition tool for initial transcripts, open-source diarization algorithm for speaker differentiation, transcription tool for narration-to-text conversion, GPT-4o-mini for merging narrations into captions, GPT-4o for expanding captions with visual-audio context and generating QA candidates, GPT-4o-mini for re-querying in EgoRAG
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset currently has limitations in terms of diversity of languages, locations, and activities covered. The data collection was limited to six participants living together for one week in a single shared house environment.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The project aims to develop AI-powered wearable glasses that enhance personal efficiency and provide meaningful life-oriented assistance. The work seeks to enable AI to become a truly efficient, empathetic, and transformative companion in human life, with potential to simplify daily activities and enhance user experience.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains extensive personal information from six participants who lived together for one week, including continuous recordings of daily activities such as discussions, shopping, cooking, socializing, and entertainment. This includes egocentric multimodal video capture, audio transcripts, visual-audio narrations, and tracking of health habits and consumption patterns.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for training and evaluating AI assistants for egocentric life assistance, including tasks such as locating misplaced items, recalling past events, tracking health habits, analyzing social interactions, and making personalized recommendations. It supports research in ultra-long egocentric video understanding, synchronized human behaviors, ego-exo alignment, and multimodal modeling of human life.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The project plans to expand the dataset to cover a broader range of languages, locations, and activities, and develop more sophisticated models. The datasets, models, and benchmarks are being released to stimulate further research.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A rigorous data cleaning process was implemented to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: We started transcript annotation after synchronizing all the egocentric videos... reviewers refined each track... The captioning tool is a video editing software with dubbing functions... annotators to provide continuous, detailed narrations... Using GPT-4o-mini, we merged related phrases into 25K 'merged captions'... verified by human annotators... We crafted prompts for each type and fed 'visual-audio captions' into GPT-4o in batches... These AI-generated questions were provided to annotators as SRT files... filtered the 100K QA candidates down to 1K high-quality questions per participant... This final round of curation resulted in a carefully crafted set of 500 QA per participant. Annotators also generated distractors for multiple-choice questions... they annotated whether audio was required to answer the question and specified the look-back time (certification length)
